subject: Veridian executive workshop — on-site logistics & travel for CEO/CTO visit
messages:
From: Claire Dumont <claire.dumont@veridianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-26T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Veridian executive workshop — on-site logistics & travel for CEO/CTO visit

Hi Soojin,

Following our discovery call, Martin (CEO) and Priya (CTO) are planning to be in SF the week of March 15 for a two‑day strategy workshop with product/engineering leadership. Can Redwood help coordinate travel logistics and onsite support for the meetings on March 16–17? Our EA (me) will manage their travel but I want to align on the following items so we can share a single itinerary with the EAs:

- Preferred meeting room and AV setup (two adjacent rooms; one for closed executive discussions)
- Arrival windows and airport transfers for Martin and Priya (both arriving evening March 15 — ETA to hotel by 20:30)
- Secure badge provisioning and short notice NDA / guest network access for attendees
- Dietary needs and ground contact for the evening networking dinner

If you can send a short draft plan and note what you need from us (passport names, preferred hotels, parking passes, any vendor contracts), we’ll aim to finalize by March 5. Attaching Veridian attendee roster.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Dumont
Executive Assistant to Martin Kaine, CEO
Veridian Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Veridian executive workshop — on-site logistics & travel for CEO/CTO visit

Claire — great to hear; we’re excited to host. Draft plan below and attached (RDW_veridian_exec_onsite_plan_v1.pdf). Please review and flag anything missing.

High-level timeline (March 15–17):
- Mar 15 evening: VIP arrivals — concierge meet & greet at the hotel (we recommend Hyatt Embarcadero or Four Seasons; we can block a small suite contingent).
- Mar 16 morning: Executive briefing (Room A — 9:00–12:30), lunch in private dining room (12:30–13:30), breakout sessions (Room B — 14:00–17:00).
- Mar 16 evening: Networking dinner (private room) — 18:30 pickup from hotel.
- Mar 17: Deep-dive technical sessions (Room B) and wrap (Room A) — 9:00–15:00.

AV / security notes:
- We’ll reserve Room A with full soundproofing and a small stage for the exec presentation. Room B will be set up for whiteboarding and live demo feeds. See attached venue_av_layout.png for proposed mic/camera placements.
- Redwood can pre-provision guest VPN tokens for all attendees, and we can run a short security bridge before the first session for sensitive demos. For badge printing we’ll need full legal names + government ID type for Martin/Priya (for expedited escort passes).

Travel & logistics split of responsibilities (proposed):
- Veridian EA (Claire): confirm exact flight itineraries and any preferred hotel choices — we’ll need names to issue guest parking passes.
- Redwood: book meeting rooms, AV vendor, dinner reservation, print badges, coordinate on‑site security and escort. Connor will own ground transport vendor coordination; Laura will manage AV and mute checks.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm arrival times on March 15 for Martin and Priya (airlines & flight numbers if available).
2) Passport/legal names for expedited badge provisioning.
3) Any dietary restrictions for dinner.

Attachments: RDW_veridian_exec_onsite_plan_v1.pdf; attendee_badge_list.csv

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Program Manager, Customer Events
Redwood Inference

- For the executive room we should provision a discrete wired presentation feed (no Wi‑Fi dependency) and an isolated demo VLAN for Priya's team. Security will need an AUP signed by the CTO for demo access.

- Badge list: please remove any personal emails and include legal names — I’ll send the printer-ready file to facilities.

Connor — can you confirm availability of our vendor for March 16–17 and whether we can secure a backup laptop/quantized jump drive (firm requirement from product demos)?
